sources.title: WISDM Smartphone and Smartwatch Activity and Biometrics Dataset
sources.snippet: For a detailed description of the dataset, please see the following pdf file that is stored with the data: WISDM-dataset-description.pdf. The raw accelerometer and gyroscope sensor data is collected from the smartphone and smartwatch at a rate of 20Hz. sources.title: WisDM - Remote IoT Fleet LoRaWAN Gateway Management System
sources.snippet: WisDM is an all-in-one remote IoT fleet management system by RAKwireless. Find out how you can configure, manage, and monitor hundreds of lorawan gateways with WisDM here.
